canonical.location: Central Luzon (Nueva Ecija and Bulacan provinces)
canonical.project_name: 菲律宾中部吕宋3.5GW光伏+4.5GWh储能项目
canonical.project_name_en: Philippines Central Luzon 3.5GW Solar + 4.5GWh BESS Project

articles.author: PV Magazine
articles.content:
Terra Solar Philippines Inc. (TSPI), a subsidiary of SP New Energy Corp. (SPNEC), has awarded Energy China an EPC contract to develop the Terra Solar project in central Luzon.
The PHP 185.28 billion ($3.25 billion) project, touted as the world’s largest contiguous solar and battery power plant under development, will feature 3.5 GW of solar panels and a 4.5 GWh battery energy storage system. It will span 3,500 hectares across the provinces of Nueva Ecija and Bulacan.
Energy China and its affiliates will oversee the project’s procurement, design, engineering, permitting, manufacturing, testing, logistics, and delivery. The company will also handle warranty coverage, address defects, implement operational and maintenance protocols, develop specialized training for local teams and maintenance protocols to ensure the project’s long-term reliability and success.
The project's groundbreaking ceremony took place at the start of this year. Construction is progressing in two phases, with the first stage scheduled for commercial operation by February 2026 and the second by February 2027.
In August, the Board of Investments of the Philippines granted a green lane certificate to the project, allowing for easier processing of permits.
According to figures from the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA), the Philippines had 1.7 GW of deployed solar at the end of 2023. Authorities have forecast that up to 2 GW of new solar could be added this year.
articles.title: Contractor selected for world’s largest solar plant in the Philippines

articles.author: NA
articles.content:
对于菲律宾电力投资商而言，土地与并网接入是最值得关注、最常导致项目延期的两大风险源。土地风险主要由私有土地或农业用地征用困难、审批复杂导致，而并网接入风险，一方面受电网容量限制，原扩容计划、电力互联工程进度滞后，另一方面也受输电线路土地/路权、监管审批周期等因素影响。
值得关注的是，备受瞩目的菲律宾最大光储项目MTerra Solar项目于近日通过菲律宾能源监管委员会（ERC）的电网接入审批，批准通过开发商建设专用点对点输电设施并接入Luzon电网。
虽然电网接入获得批准，但由于本项目新建变电站（永久接入点）预计将在2031-2040年才可投入使用，在此之前仅能通过临时接入点进行输电。这一现象，既是发电侧建设速度与电网侧升级速度之间的结构性矛盾，同时也反映出菲律宾电力项目并网过程中“电网瓶颈”问题的共性特点。
项目背景
该项目位于吕宋岛的新怡诗夏省（Nueva Ecija）和布拉干省（Bulacan），规划总装机容量为3.5GW光伏电站+ 4.5GWh储能。
项目由由Meralco PowerGen（MGEN）及其子公司SP New Energy Corporation（SPNEC）主导开发。英国投资公司Actis以6亿美元对价收购项目40%股权，工程建设由中国能建（Energy China）、中国电建（PowerChina）及Meralco工业工程服务公司（MIESCOR）负责实施。
项目关键事件路径图
最新进展
一期项目装机规模为1.5 GW 光伏+ 2 GWh 储能。截至2025年7月，一期项目已建设完成54%，进度超预期。线路方面，截至2025年9月，输电线路建设进度已达90%，预计专有输电设施将接入现有 500 千伏 Nagsaag-San Jose 输电线路以及San Isidro 500 kV变电站。
总体来看，中企建设的MTerra Solar 项目的建设进展提振了海外大型电力项目建设的信心，也为菲律宾能源市场注入了积极信号。然而，电网接入问题，仍然是影响菲律宾新能源投资项目按期投运的关键风险。对于中国企业而言，深入理解和提前规避电网接入及土地征用等复杂问题，依然菲律宾电力投资项目成功的关键所在。
articles.title: 菲律宾最大光储项目电网接入获批，两家中企参建
